arguments.sql:
SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate, c.types, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.power) AS powers, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.toughness) AS toughnesses
FROM main.sets AS s
JOIN main.cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.code IN (SELECT setCode FROM main.cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen')
  AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
GROUP BY s.code, s.releaseDate, c.types
ORDER BY s.releaseDate DESC

arguments.sql:
WITH matching_sets AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
    FROM main.sets AS s
    WHERE s.code IN (
        SELECT c.setCode
        FROM main.cards AS c
        WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS creature_count
FROM main.cards AS c
WHERE c.setCode IN (
    SELECT code
    FROM matching_sets
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM matching_sets)
)
  AND instr(',' || c.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
  AND CAST(CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) = c.power
  AND CAST(CAST(c.toughness AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) = c.toughness
  AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) > CAST(c.toughness AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 1
